post.caption: Gold is not weighed in regular ounces. A troy ounce is 31.1 grams, against 28.35 grams for an everyday ounce. A troy pound has just 12 ounces, so it is the lighter pound. Many jewelers use pennyweights, and 20 of them make a troy ounce. A pennyweight is 24 grains, or about 1.55 grams. The system is usually thought to be named for Troyes, France. In 1527, England made troy weight official for gold and silver, and it is still the standard for gold and other precious metals today. Karat measures purity in 24ths, so 18 karat is 75 percent gold.
